item.title: Minnesota attorney general sues Texas governor to compel extradition of ICE agent for trial
item.description: Minnesota’s attorney general is suing the governor of Texas, asking a federal judge to compel the extradition of a federal immigration agent charged with wounding a man and then lying about it during an immigration crackdown in Minneapolis.
